scope: Wallet received Confidential Intents requests, exact sender-owner consent and durable submission/status recovery
limits: Disposable Edge profiles, synthetic signatures/providers and loopback HTTP; no real financial operation or live private settlement.
The device journal enforces sender-owner consent; Host/Origin checks do not authenticate another local process. Remote exposure needs separate executor authentication.
Known Ethereum, Arbitrum and Base ETH display metadata is built in; other assets remain saved/checkable with submission paused.
Provider reports remain unverified and cannot credit funds or release reservations.
Physical delivery, independent private credit/settlement/refund and financial recovery remain outside these checks.
retainedFailures: Initial happy-path fixture compared an unused payload field that the owner outbox intentionally excludes; corrected expected offer.
An early candidate copy used its own directory as source; corrected absolute source path.
The clean offline cache initially lacked generated proof dependencies; the existing verified test-only build restored them.
The timeout mutation raised its specific expected timeout error; the harness initially expected only an assertion error and was corrected.
